title: Families of proper minimal surfaces
summary: Assume that $X$ is a connected, open, oriented smooth surface, $B$ is a compact Euclidean neighbourhood retract, and $\mathscr{J}=\{J_b\}_{b\in B}$ is a continuous family of complex structures on $X$ of local Hölder class $\mathscr{C}^α$ for some $0<α<1$. We construct a continuous family of $J_b$-conformal minimal immersions $u_b:X\to \mathbb{R}^3$, $b\in B$, properly projecting to $\mathbb{R}^2$ and having an arbitrary given family of flux homomorphisms ${\rm Flux}_{u_b}:H_1(X,\mathbb{Z})\to\mathbb{R}^3$.
